patch.objective: Leveraging technical skills to deliver results: process optimization, project management, and risk response

sources.cite: PMI, PMI PMO Certified Professional (PMI-PMOCP) Examination Content Outline and Specifications, January 2025 (v2): Organizational Development and Alignment 16%, PMO Strategic Elements 18%, PMO Design and Structuring 18%, PMO Operation and Performance 15%, PMO Enhancement and Effectiveness 18%, People 15%
sources.note: Read 2026-11-17 through a summarizing fetch of a study page (masteryexamprep, dated 2025-12-20) that cites PMI's outline of January 2025 (v2) for these weights. The page lists no task statements; it says questions reward 'governance realism: decision rights, thresholds, escalation paths, and reporting that drives decisions'. PMI's PDF (the course seed cites it) was not opened; the task wording is the course seed's, to verify. Reused for REQ-336 from this course's water-utility-rebalance-pmipmocp (the same reading and date); the objective wording is the course seed's.

The organization, the project, the figures and the people are fictional. The minutes or days each step takes and the effects of each decision are teaching simplifications for exam practice, not measured values.
